description: This file defines the `BuzzCommentDecorator` class, which is part of the OrangeHRM system. The class acts as a decorator for the `BuzzComment` entity, providing methods to set related entities (`Employee`, `BuzzShare`), retrieve formatted creation date and time, check if the current authenticated user liked the comment, and manage likes count. It uses multiple traits for access to services and helpers, indicating it's part of the application's core infrastructure for handling Buzz comments within the HRM system.

classes.name: BuzzCommentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the BuzzComment entity that adds additional functionality such as setting related entities, retrieving formatted dates, checking user likes, and managing likes count within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee entity related to the BuzzComment based on an employee number.

methods.name: setShareById
methods.description: Associates a BuzzShare entity with the BuzzComment based on its ID.

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Returns the creation date of the comment in Y-m-d format.

methods.name: getCreatedTime
methods.description: Returns the creation time of the comment in H:i format.

methods.name: isAuthEmployeeLiked
methods.description: Checks if the authenticated employee has liked the comment.

methods.name: increaseNumOfLikesByOne
methods.description: Increment the number of likes for the comment by one.

methods.name: decreaseNumOfLikesByOne
methods.description: Decrement the number of likes for the comment by one.
